entries.0adc641afb056d45: A chemical manufacturer headquartered in Kobe that handles metal surface treatment agents such as plating solutions, electronic materials, automotive chemical products and industrial chemicals.
entries.2aca98a71203632e: It develops, manufactures and sells professional-use chemical products for the automotive aftermarket, and anti-spatter agents for welding. The company and Ishihara Kabi (Shanghai) Shangmao Youxian Gongsi are responsible; revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,878 million.
entries.37718c43c84d40a6: It procures machinable ceramics and engineering plastics with high heat resistance and electrical insulation as materials, machines them to customer specifications, and sells them as parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and inspection equipment.
entries.73f238f7260c66f5: Metal Surface Treatment Agents and Equipment
entries.77251e20b714f623: It sells carbon fiber reinforced plastic as parts for transfer equipment for wafers and liquid crystal panels.
entries.906cd93c77988b8c: It purchases and sells highly specialized products used in the production processes of major steel and chemical users, and chemicals for government agencies. Main products include surface treatment agents for automotive steel sheets, catalysts, activated carbon and water treatment agents; most are shipped directly from suppliers to customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,686 million.
entries.997f253cefd55bf3: It develops, manufactures and sells equipment that automatically analyzes chemical treatment solutions, such as electroless plating solutions used in printed circuit board processing and developers used in flat panel manufacturing, and automatically manages replenishment of insufficient chemicals. It also develops, manufactures and sells reagents used in these devices.
entries.9b69028e525a9c98: Chemical Treatment Solution Automatic Management Equipment and Others
entries.b30046db07ed377c: It develops, manufactures and sells agents that prevent the adhesion of spatter (molten iron particles) scattered during electric welding of construction machinery and steel frames for building construction. When spatter adheres around welded areas, it causes peeling of topcoat paint and rust.
entries.d688c8018553a355: It develops, manufactures and sells metal surface treatment agents, such as tin-based and copper plating solutions, and automatic management equipment for chemical treatment solutions. The company, Ishihara Kabi (Shanghai) Shangmao Youxian Gongsi, Ishihara Kabi (Shanghai) Keji Youxian Gongsi and Kizai Co., Ltd. are responsible; revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,959 million, making it the largest business in the group.
entries.e3549774d3771510: It develops, manufactures and sells tin-based plating solution used to join electronic components and printed wiring boards in a conductive state, and copper plating solution used for fine circuit formation and securing conductivity in semiconductors and printed wiring boards. It also provides technical support, such as setting plating conditions and evaluating and improving plating films, and manages plating solution lines.
entries.ead3a1683a52fbec: It procures machinable ceramics and engineering plastics used in parts of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and inspection equipment as materials, and machines and sells them to customer specifications. It sells carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) as parts for transfer equipment for wafers and liquid crystal panels. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥925 million.
entries.f3215b14f9afdf2c: It develops, manufactures and sells professional-use chemical products for the automotive aftermarket, including air conditioner cleaners, maintenance chemicals such as brake parts cleaners and lubricants, compounds for paint repair, polishing agents, coating agents, repair chemicals, and car wash agents for car wash machines.
